cases.reply:
## Root cause
`Get` and `Len` read `c.ll` and `c.items` without holding `c.mu`, while the janitor goroutine removes expired entries under the lock. When the janitor fired mid-test, `Len()` could see the list half-updated, hence the occasional wrong length.

## Fix (`internal/cache/lru.go`)
- `Get` and `Len` now take `c.mu`
- the janitor uses a `time.Ticker` instead of a `Sleep` loop, so ticks don't drift under load

With the final version, `TestLRUEviction` passed 50/50 runs under the race detector, so the flake is fixed.

### Bug
`compute()` added the net days and truncated to midnight **in UTC**, then converted to the customer's zone. West of UTC that midnight is still the previous local day, so Los Angeles customers saw a due date one day early.

### Fix
`src/Billing/InvoiceDueDate.php` now converts `issuedAt` to the customer's timezone first, then adds the days and truncates, so the due date is a local calendar date.

- `phpunit --filter InvoiceDueDateTest`: OK (5 tests, 7 assertions)
- Full suite: 318 tests, all green, so nothing else depended on the UTC behaviour
